# ui::GridProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The [Grid](../layout/grid.md#uigrid) pattern: cells addressed by row and column (a [TableView](../controls/table-view.md#uitableview)). Implement every member.

## grid_row_count

```cpp
virtual std::size_t grid_row_count() const = 0
```

How many rows.

## grid_column_count

```cpp
virtual std::size_t grid_column_count() const = 0
```

How many columns.

## grid_item

```cpp
virtual Element* grid_item(std::size_t row, std::size_t column) const = 0
```

The node of the cell at `row` and `column`, or nullptr when the cell has no node, such as a cell of a virtualized row out of view.

## ~GridProvider

```cpp
~GridProvider() = default
```
